title: Matching Donations - Double Gifts Without Asking for More
actionable_recommendations: Collect employer data from donors and volunteers on donation and registration forms.
Create a dedicated matching gift page linked to the ways to give page on your website.
Make matching gift information accessible through various communication channels.
Send personalized matching gift reminders based on gathered employer data.
Include matching gift details in social media posts and during events.
claims_requiring_current_verification: The average open rate of a matching gift email sent within 24 hours of a donation is 53%.
Sending a second matching gift reminder email increases matches submitted by 48%.
4 to 7 billion dollars in matching gifts go unclaimed annually.
major_ideas: Matching donations are a valuable yet often overlooked fundraising strategy for small nonprofits.
Many donors are unaware of their eligibility for matching gifts, leading to billions of unclaimed dollars.
Collecting employer data from donors can significantly improve matching gift retrieval.
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of donor engagement strategies.
Understanding of matching gifts and workplace giving programs.
proposed_workflow: Ask for employer information on donation forms and volunteer registrations.
Create a matching gift information page on the website.
Increase awareness through social media and various communications.
Send timely reminders to donors about matching gift opportunities.
tools_templates_resources: Templates for donation forms and communication materials.
Suggested FAQ for matching gift information page on the website.
